articles.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
articles.snippet: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

articles.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

articles.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
articles.snippet: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

articles.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
articles.snippet: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

articles.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
articles.snippet: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
